title: Install
*Lazarus*
ytTitle: How to install Lazarus on Windows (free Pascal IDE)
desc:
Install Lazarus 4.8 with Free Pascal 3.2.2 on Windows, step by step, and run your first Pascal program. For South African IT pupils and teachers.

In this video:
- Downloading the 64-bit Windows installer from lazarus-ide.org
- Installing to C:\lazarus - a short path with no spaces
- Choosing the Modern, single-window layout at the first start
- Saving a first program in your cloud-synced Coding folder
- Running Hello from Lazarus! with F9

0:00 Intro
0:22 Download Lazarus
1:07 Save the installer to Downloads\Installs
1:44 Run the installer
2:23 Keep the folder C:\lazarus
3:14 First start: the Modern layout
3:49 A new program
4:06 Save it in your Coding folder
5:12 Run it with F9
5:41 Done

Goes with the Pascal course lesson "Where you write Pascal - Lazarus and Delphi", and the first lesson, "Getting your computer set up to study programming", at https://bestlessons.co.za
